title: Archive and Horizon
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
